data.text: Enemy cannot cast effects while in contact with you.

logic.description: Implemented permanent. While it stands, every enemy in contact with the caster has its casts blocked (resolveEffect status blocked, "emotions bombard in contact"). ∀ double cast: the two Emotions bombard are resolved as an instant chain in one go (EVERY_INSTANT). Placed with a point-buy die as Rule 24 power.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).

effects.description: Rule 12: the permanent is placed with a point-buy die (re-rolled until the sum fits); that die is its power under Rule 24.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys this permanent when it is at least the token value behind the cast element.
Enemy casts are blocked while the enemy is within this distance of the holder.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_vitality (the element family that defines the effect).
